info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Careers Applications Feedbacks-v4-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve feedback for various career applications within the system. It provides a comprehensive view of all feedback submissions related to job applications, making it a vital resource for HR professionals and hiring managers. By leveraging this endpoint, companies can assess candidate responses and improve their hiring processes based on feedback trends. Typical consumers include recruitment teams and talent acquisition specialists seeking to enhance applicant experience and streamline evaluation.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all feedback related to applications. It's essential for understanding user opinions and improving application services.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit feedback about applications. The data must be formatted as a JSON object and should contain the necessary fields for the feedback operation.

200.description: The request was successful and feedback data is returned.
